item.title: Maher was amused by Trump’s Pearl Harbor joke to Japanese leader, says ‘if Shane Gillis said it, you’d laugh’
item.summary: Bill Maher defended Trump's Pearl Harbor joke to Japan's PM Takaichi, saying it wasn't appropriate but was funny, while criticizing the president's handling of Iran conflict.

item.title: University leader admits schools are 'not a political party' in warning to elite campuses
item.summary: Vanderbilt chancellor warns elite universities risk failure by prioritizing political activism over education mission amid Trump administration scrutiny.

item.title: Trump threatens to deploy ICE agents to airports amid funding fight, vows arrests of illegal aliens
item.summary: President Donald Trump warns he will deploy ICE agents to U.S. airports to arrest illegal immigrants if Democrats refuse to meet his demands to end the government shutdown.

item.title: IOC addresses execution of 19-year-old Iranian wrestler Saleh Mohammadi
item.summary: The IOC expressed concern over the reported execution of 19-year-old Iranian wrestling star Saleh Mohammadi but says it cannot change a sovereign nation's laws.

item.title: FBI raids Hollywood mansion in $17.4M alleged mortgage scam targeting seniors, 11 arrested including Iranian
item.summary: FBI agents raided a Hollywood mansion early Thursday, arresting a suspect in pajamas in a raid tied to an alleged $17.4 million mortgage fraud scheme targeting elderly homeowners.

item.title: NBA champion Thunder to skip White House visit, citing 'timing' issue
item.summary: The 2025 NBA champion Oklahoma City Thunder won't visit the White House, citing timing issues after talks with the administration did not work out.

item.title: Why some US airports are dodging TSA shutdown chaos while others grind to a halt
item.summary: Some US airports are dodging government shutdown chaos thanks to private TSA screening contractors who get paid despite the funding standoff.

item.title: ‘Grandparents’ happy hour’ bill would let senior homes serve alcohol without a license
item.summary: Minnesota’s 'Grandparents' Happy Hour' bill would allow assisted living facilities to serve alcohol without a liquor license — which supporters call unnecessary 'red tape.'

item.title: Former FBI Director Robert Mueller dies at 81, Trump reacts
UCLA's Skyy Clark loses front tooth in March Madness thriller to help Bruins seal first-round victory
item.summary: UCLA's Skyy Clark lost half a front tooth in the NCAA tournament but returned to hit a key free throw, helping the Bruins defeat UCF 75-71 on Friday.
